news.title: Global tech selloff deepens as AI-spending fears outweigh Huang's Nvidia return
news.text: Investors kept selling tech stocks Wednesday on doubts about the AI boom's durability; Nasdaq futures were down ~3.2% in early trading per CNN. Nvidia's pop from Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO did not hold. South Korea's Kospi fell 6.2% on memory-chip weakness; Anthropic shares remain below their IPO price.

news.title: Nutanix (NTNX) slides on soft Q2 guidance and CEO exit despite a Q1 beat
news.text: Fiscal Q1 2027 revenue ($772.4M) and adjusted EPS ($0.73) both beat estimates, but Q2 revenue guidance (~$825M midpoint) missed the ~$835.7M consensus, and CEO Rajiv Ramaswami said he will step down once a successor is found. Piper Sandler and Oppenheimer both cut price targets today while keeping positive ratings.
